searchText: <@376568077950910466> I left a couple comments (I'm not sure if you have GitHub email notifications enabled). Thanks! That all makes sense, looks like it already got auto-merged but I'm happy to revert to using `EIP1559_INITIAL_GAS_TARGET`. It is unclear to me whether it is worth the effort or not. 😬 The change I proposed is just one to reduce theoretical future maintenance, and there is a non-zero cost in applying it. So we would apply a nonzero cost for benefit we may never realize.
